game: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time (Switch 2 Remake)

medals.name: Citizen of Hyrule
medals.description: Earned by increasing your playtime stat
medals.notes: Natural progression takes ~30-35 hours for in-game 100%; AFK time counts toward this medal

medals.name: Monster's Bane
medals.description: Earned by increasing your enemies defeated stat
medals.notes: Comes naturally by Hall of Fallen Foes completion

medals.name: Wealthy
medals.description: Earned by increasing your rupees collected stat
medals.notes: With 100 Skulltulas, talk to the guy in Kakariko house for 200 rupees indefinitely

medals.name: Distance Tracker
medals.description: Earned by increasing your distance traveled stat
medals.notes: Comes naturally during 100% completion

medals.name: Lover of Luxury
medals.description: Earned by increasing your consumable items used stat
medals.notes: Consumables include: recovery hearts, Deku Nuts, bombs, Deku Seeds, arrows

medals.name: Economizer
medals.description: Earned by increasing your special item uses stat
medals.notes: Special items: boomerang, hookshot, bow and arrow, etc. (non-magic, non-consumable)

medals.name: Magic User
medals.description: Earned by increasing your magic power use stat
medals.notes: Magic-using items: Lens of Truth, Din's Fire, Farore's Wind, Nayru's Love, Fire/Ice/Light Arrows

medals.name: Treasure Hunter
medals.description: Earned by increasing your treasure chests opened stat
medals.notes: For true 100%, open every single treasure chest in the game (map shows all chest locations)

medals.name: Quest Challenger
medals.description: Earned by increasing your events completed stat
medals.notes: Complete all side quests and events to max this stat

medals.name: Token Collector
medals.description: Earned by collecting Gold Skulltulas
medals.notes: Already tracked in existing checklist.json (100 Gold Skulltulas); display: false keeps it out of the WIP My Play Data card

medals.name: Traveler
medals.description: Earned by visiting locations
medals.notes: Visit everywhere you can; comes naturally during 100% completion

medals.name: Social Butterfly
medals.description: Earned by talking to NPCs
medals.notes: Talk to every NPC as Young Link AND Adult Link (many move from Castle Town to Kakariko Village)

medals.name: Hero of Historic Battles
medals.description: Earned by fighting battles in the Hall of Fallen Foes
medals.notes: Doesn't require winning; just attempt the battles. Naturally earned when going for Hall Master Medals

medals.name: Game Player
medals.description: Earned by playing mini-games
medals.notes: Doesn't require winning; can fail to go quicker. Bomb Chu Alley is fastest for grinding. 20-25 plays after in-game 100%

medals.name: Angler
medals.description: Earned by catching fish
medals.notes: Catch-and-release counts; just catch small fish. 5→50 takes ~30-45 minutes

medals.name: Grass Slasher
medals.description: Earned by cutting grass with your sword
medals.notes: Comes naturally if you hack away at grass regularly

medals.name: Crusher
medals.description: Earned by destroying pots
medals.notes: Pots respawn in guard tower in Hyrule Castle Town (Child Link); no way to trigger spawn manually

medals.name: Musician
medals.description: Earned by playing the Ocarina
medals.notes: Play 100 songs; comes naturally during gameplay

medals.name: Explorer
medals.description: Earned by increasing your map completion stat
medals.notes: 100% the Zelda Notes map (all locations, chests, hidden holes, etc.)

medals.name: amiibo Enthusiast
medals.description: Earned by scanning amiibo
medals.notes: Only Zelda amiibo work; can scan same one daily (50 days minimum if you have one amiibo). 33/35 available as of 2026-11-24 (2 OoT amiibo release 2027)

medals.name: Hall Conqueror
medals.description: Earned by getting every Master Medal in the Hall of Fallen Foes
medals.notes: Very difficult; some (like King Dodongo) are especially hard. Requires Master Medal clear times on all Hall battles

medals.name: Quiz Enthusiast
medals.description: Earned by completing the Ocarina of Time Quiz
medals.notes: APP-ONLY: Complete Cucco level (30 consecutive correct answers). Once per 24 hours OR spend rupees (20/60/100) for retries. Unlocks Cojiro Challenge after, but Cojiro is NOT required for Master Medal. OUT OF SCOPE for tracker (no in-game stat)

out_of_scope: Quiz Enthusiast — app-only quiz with no in-game stat counter
already_tracked: Token Collector (100 Gold Skulltulas) — already in checklist.json as heart_pieces/gold_skulltulas categories
in_game_requirements: All capacity upgrades (Giant's Wallet, max Deku Stick/Nut/Seed/Bomb bags, max Quiver)
Din's Fire, Farore's Wind, Nayru's Love
Happy Mask Salesman quest + Mask of Truth
Hall of Fallen Foes: all battles + all Master Medals
zelda_notes_app_features: Transfer rupees from in-game to Zelda Notes (20/60/100 per 24 hours) for quiz retries
Map view with treasure chests, hidden holes, completion tracking
My Play Data shows all medals with progress
Photo Studio to decorate screenshots with medals/stamps
Ocarina of Time Quiz (Egg → Cucco levels)
